title: More like this, from the titles themselves, with the reason shown
description: Serves "Finding something to watch is easy."; "Their data is theirs.". D-124: suggestions come from local metadata and from the viewer, never learned from other viewers' watching. Absorbs JS-049.
acceptanceCriteria: For a title, the viewer sees titles like it (same franchise, director, cast, genre or decade), each with its reason, leaving out titles they have watched.
Nothing is learned from other viewers' watching, and another account's history never shapes a viewer's suggestions.
Only titles the viewer may see are suggested (JS-036).
A viewer with no history gets a sensible answer, and another account's history never shapes a viewer's suggestions
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check. Nothing leaves the server.
notes: No surface is built for one client; a viewer in a browser sees the suggestions too.
